suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
})
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x))]
  unique(trimws(x))
}
set_list <- list(
  A = clean_set(df$A), B = clean_set(df$B), C = clean_set(df$C),
  D = clean_set(df$D), E = clean_set(df$E)
)
cat("Sets sizes:\n")
print(sapply(set_list, length))
p <- ggVennDiagram(set_list, label_alpha = 0, label_color = "black", edge_color = "black", edge_size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "#4980B5") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  labs(title = "5 -set synthetic Venn diagram", subtitle = sprintf("Total  %d  unique  ID", length(unique(unlist(set_list)))), fill = "Intersection size") +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"), legend.position = "right")
ggsave("venn_5sets.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved: venn_5sets.png\n")
print(p)
